_comment: The single source of truth for versions. BEAM_VERSION used to be hardcoded in 13 files
across bash, batch, PowerShell, Inno Pascal, JS and Markdown, and the app version
disagreed with itself four ways. Every installer and serve.py reads this file instead.
sha256 values are the hash of the EXTRACTED binary, cross-checked against the
*-checksum.txt that BeamMW ships inside each archive. Pinning them here means a
substituted upstream artifact fails verification, which a checksum fetched from the
same place as the binary would not catch.
min_consensus_height is the HF6 activation block. A node that cannot pass it is out of
consensus no matter what its own logs claim about being synced.

hardfork.name: HF6
hardfork.note: Builds older than min_beam_version stall one block before this height and never recover.

windows._note: Assets are prefixed 'win-', not 'windows-'. Two installers requested the wrong name and 404'd.

_note: BeamMW ships no macOS build of the HF6 hotfix — their last mac release is
7.5.13882 (2024-05-25), which stalls forever at block 3928665. These are
built from the beam-7.5.14493 tag ourselves; see docs/BUILDING_BEAM_MACOS.md.
Verified on 2026-08-04: Rules signature carries 3928666-96df3f33ee02ad9e and
the binary syncs to the live tip against a public node.
arm64 only. Rebuild from the tag when upstream bumps.
